name: customer-impact-stats
title: Customer Impact Stats
description: A quantitative impact report showing cumulative developer hours saved and issues mitigated.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Mosaic
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Customer Impact Stats Interaction: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
